note: GMUG (Gunnison RD) campground in a narrow aspen valley 4 mi up Cement Creek Rd (FR 740, fairly wide dirt with some washboard) off CO-135, 7.5 mi southeast of Crested Butte. The loop is narrow with tight turns: a 23-ft rig is comfortable, 30 ft and up is discouraged. Sites 3-9 sit along the creek. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 10165210 (Scan and Pay listing): confirmed 13 sites, vault toilets, FCFS only, $18 (+$9 vehicle). Changed potable_water false->true (FS: 'Potable water is available'). Added season 05-23..10-01. Note's 'no potable water (creek only)' and field restatements removed.
flags: Missing phone: Gunnison Ranger District (970) 641-0471 (GMUG offices page; the campground's FS page lists no contact).

Waterfront: the brief says 'creekside' is not in the vocabulary, but docs/campground-curation.md lists `creekside` as an on-water value (for streams under ~30 m wide), so the stored value is valid in form. It has NO waterfront_evidence, though. recreation.gov has no per-site coordinates (one placeholder site at the facility point), and the Esri imagery is a winter scene: the loop runs south off FR 740 to a cross road; Cement Creek runs east-west along the campground's south edge under aspen and spruce, and is not visible at the pads. The imagery can neither confirm nor rule out an open apron; the only claim of creekside sites is the note's own 'Sites 3-9 sit along the creek' (unsourced). Under default-down this is unproven: re-audit lead, waterfront NOT changed.
Max length: the FS page and recreation.gov state none; no max_rig_ft is stored. The note's tight-loop caveat (30 ft+ discouraged) is unsourced but does not affect a 23-ft rig.
Status: the only GMUG alert (Gold Mountain Wildfire road/trail closure, order 02-04-06-26-29) covers the Ouray RD, not FR 740. The campground is closed for the season (Oct 1).
Pin 38.82861,-106.83546 is ~28 m from the FS/rec.gov point (38.828863,-106.835436), on the campground's entrance spur. OK.
